messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites GNU C++17 code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

<perturbed_code_1>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cmath>
#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;
long long num11[20];
long long pow10[20];
int ans = 0;
void pre()
{
    pow10[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++)
    {
        pow10[i] = pow10[i - 1] * 10;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= 17; i++)
    {
        num11[i] = num11[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
}
int get_len(long long x)
{
    int res = 0;
    while (x)
    {
        res++;
        x /= 10;
    }
    return res;
}
void dfs(int pos, long long x, int cnt)
{
    if (ans != -1 && cnt >= ans)    return;
    if (x == 0 || pos == 0)
    {
        if (ans != -1)  ans = min(ans, cnt);
        else    ans = cnt;
        return;
    }
    if (x < 0)  x = -x;
    long long t_x = x;
    int t_cnt = 0;
    while (t_x >= pow10[pos - 1])
    {
        t_x -= num11[pos];
        t_cnt += pos;
    }
    dfs(pos - 1, t_x, cnt + t_cnt);
    t_x = num11[pos + 1] - x;    t_cnt = 0;
    while (t_x >= pow10[pos - 1])
    {
        t_x -= num11[pos];
        t_cnt += pos;
    }
    dfs(pos - 1, t_x, cnt + pos + 1 + t_cnt);
}
void Solve()
{
    long long x;    scanf("%lld", &x);
    ans = -1;
    dfs(get_len(x), x, 0);
    cout << ans << '\n';
}
int main()
{
    pre();
    Solve();
    getchar(); getchar();
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
